title: Technical Product Manager (Core Platform)
description: We are looking for a Technical Product Manager to drive product strategy, roadmap prioritization, and feature execution across our cross-functional engineering teams.
responsibilities: Define product roadmap, technical requirements, and feature user stories.
Partner with engineering, UX design, and data science to deliver features on schedule.
Track product KPIs, customer adoption metrics, and run A/B experimentation.
Manage stakeholder expectations and communicate product vision to executive leadership.
requirements: 3+ years experience in product management or technical program management.
Strong technical fluency with APIs, software architecture, and agile methodologies.
Demonstrated ability to use data analytics (SQL, Tableau) to drive product decisions.
Outstanding leadership, written communication, and cross-functional coordination.
